caption: The drawing depicts a single central figure standing in an upright rectangular frame with a rounded top section. The figure is dressed in long, dark robes with a bright red cloak draped over both shoulders, and accents of green around the collar and cuffs. The facial features show a trimmed beard and mustache, and the figure wears a reddish cap with a flat top. The figure’s left hand holds a large greenish cross slanted across the body, while the right hand holds a green object resembling an orb. The background consists of warm, earthy tones such as yellow, brown, and orange and includes faded circular designs along with an angelic or human figure with wings visible on the upper right side, holding an object resembling scales. The border of the rectangular frame is dark, and the upper rounded section includes a faded circular motif colored in red and yellow. The whole scene is set on a neutral, off-white background with no additional objects or elements outside the central image.
title: Santo
